_meta.rename_note: F2-A canonical normalization: file was Gamma-1C.json; renamed to Gamma-1S.json after the homoglyph fix that established 'Gamma-1S' as the single ASCII canonical for the spectrometric complex internally labeled «Гамма-1С» (cyrillic 'С' U+0421 → ASCII 'S' transliteration; legacy ASCII 'Gamma-1C' kept as alias in data/aliases.json). The bogus stub Gamma-1S.json (validation_status=stub_pending_efficiency_cert, fallback_to=Gamma-1C) that previously co-existed in this directory was discarded — it described a fictitious second complex and its existence drove the Case-2 stub-fallback branch in profile.py.
_meta.author: agent-a3
_meta.purpose: Detector profile metadata for the Gamma-1S spectrometric complex (canonical ASCII name for «Гамма-1С»). Loaded by gamma.detectors.profile.load_detector_profile; metadata-only registry layer above the path resolver gamma.detectors.gamma1s.
rules: Profile is metadata only — physical assets (efficiency .efr, secondary peaks, certificates) live under detectors/Gamma-1S/.
Every field carries a provenance pointer to the authoritative source.
When a spectrum's canonical detector resolves to a name without a matching profile JSON here, the loader emits a `detector_fallback` warning (BUG-39 'profile_not_on_disk' branch).

fwhm_polynomial.comment: FWHM(E) = sqrt(c0 + c1*E + c2*E^2), keV; LSRM .spe FWHM=2 polynomial
fwhm_polynomial._provenance: Per-spectrum value: read from `.spe` FWHM=2 block via gamma.io.lsrm_spe; no fleet-wide constant for Gamma-1S — each measurement carries its stored fit.

notes: Primary calibrated unit (serial SN-01) anchors the Gamma-1S profile. Internal Russian label «Гамма-1С» (cyrillic 'С' U+0421); ASCII canonical 'Gamma-1S' = transliteration of cyrillic «С». The legacy ASCII 'Gamma-1C' form (historical homoglyph typo) is preserved as an alias in data/aliases.json for backward compatibility — it resolves to this same profile. Other physical units sharing the same УДС-ГЦ-63×63 head model are treated as separate canonicals only when CONFIGNAME genuinely differs (e.g. a future hypothetical serial-0221 complex would get its own profile JSON, not the stub fallback that was discarded 2026-06-21).
